pr_title: [Fix #7957] Fix Style/IfUnlessModifier to remain multiline if code after end keyword makes it too long
pr_body:
Fixes #7957.

issue_context.title: Infinite loop in Style/IfUnlessModifier
issue_context.body:
We're seeing an issue with the `Style/IfUnlessModifier` cop getting in an infinite loop on a long line (seemingly switching between the single-line and multi-line versions).

This started happening on v0.83.0; no violations were reported on v0.82.0.

**.rubocop.yml**

```yaml
Layout/LineLength:
  Max: 90
```

**example.rb**

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

<<~FOO.strip
  #{'Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit vivamus mollis.' if count > 1}
FOO
```

--------

To terminate without an infinite loop.

> This started happening on v0.83.0; no violations were reported on v0.82.0.

It definitely happens on v0.82.0 too.

I did a `git bisect` which says the behavior was introduced by commit e524404a1b7b5152449caf94e582c0cb8079c7da from pull request #7507.

review_comments: I really hope that no one actually writes such code. :laughing:
